svg.title: The Verse of the Agents
svg.desc: Three agents for the product-kings under the sky, Seven for the marketing-lords in their halls of stone, Nine for mortal men tied to sales, One for the dark lord on his dark throne, In the land of business where the actions lie, One agent to build them all, one agent to run them, One agent to bring them all, and in the knowledge bind them, In the land of business, where tulips lie

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, 'Book Antiqua', Georgia, serif
text.textPath: one agent to build them all · one agent to run them · one agent to bind them ·
